ruling.reasoning:
One off-route segment is code-settled: 14:33–14:48, 7.45 km driven where the optimal route covers 2.40 km, adding 5.05 km [F4][RD-1]. RD-4 does not excuse it: no incident is recorded near the route in the trip window [F16]; the Central Expressway band-2 record is only corroborative, cannot exempt alone [RD-4(b)], and covers 14:11–14:33, before the segment, while the roads around the stop run free-flowing [F13][F14][F15][RD-4(a)].

Consent: the driver asked at 14:29 whether to take another way [F9] and the rider replied at 14:30, before the 14:33 segment start, “Just take whichever way is faster lah, I'm late” [F10]. That is a rider message sent before the segment, so consent exists [RD-5]. Its scope, read from the words, is a GENERAL route choice — permission to pick a faster route to the destination, not to run the driver's own errand [RD-5]. The driver's own post-trip statement says he “stopped briefly to collect something on the way” [F12]; the only stop is 4 min 0 s at a point 7443 m from pickup and 6033 m from drop-off, neither a pickup nor a drop-off point [F2]; and the complete, fully timestamped chat record [F11] contains no rider message naming any place, so no RD-3(a) exemption for a rider-named stop applies [RD-3(a)]. Nothing in the timed record ties the 7.45 km drive to the destination-directed alternative (the fact table carries no road names for the driven path), and the driver's own statement explains the segment by a stop he chose to make for his own purpose — a stop away from the route, of the kind the policy says the general authorisation does not cover [RD-5][RD-3(b)]. The single segment therefore counts in full; the general consent does not rescue it.

Amount: the whole 5.05 km extra distance of the non-exempt segment is refundable [F4][RD-2]. Rate = distance fare ÷ distance km = $29.44 ÷ 20.88 km = $1.4100/km [F8][F5]; 5.05 km × $1.4100/km = $7.1205 → $7.12 [F4][F5][RD-2]. The metered waiting charge of $1.15 for 4.4 min [F6] is the RydeTAXI meter's own waiting unit and is not refunded [RD-3(c)]. RD-6 is not engaged: the driver has 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F19][RD-6], so no flag_account and no escalation.

SAFE-1 screen: the chat is a route negotiation [F9][F10] and the driver's statement is an admission about a stop [F12]; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation — none found.
